title: ISBN uniqueness forces 409 on second book with no isbn
evidence: handlers.go:41/266 schema `isbn TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE`; createBook (handlers.go:95) only validates title+author, so a missing isbn defaults to empty string — the second book created without an isbn collides on the UNIQUE constraint and returns 409 (handlers.go:123). Spec requires only title+author; isbn uniqueness is self-imposed.
suggestion: Either make isbn optional/nullable (drop the UNIQUE-on-empty case) or document that isbn must be unique and non-empty.
